name: session-hub
description: Companion plugin for the Zensu Session Hub: the /session-hub:session-trail takeover the Hub types, its handover receipt and the usage feed.

allow_unsigned_courier.title: Accept an unsigned Session Hub courier
allow_unsigned_courier.description: For development builds of the Zensu Session Hub only. Lets this plugin start a courier that does not carry the Session Hub release signature. Leave it off on every other Mac.
